shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml && git log -5 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 120 npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\" && sed -n '1,200p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs && sed -n '1,200p' jest.config.js 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,180p'; git diff --check; git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 120 npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix registry test assertion lint" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
